pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Bug fix matches PR words. The fix has one obvious design (escape and ESCAPE clause), so it needed no spec.
No spec file in the change.

The new tests insert titles containing %, _ and a backslash, and assert exact result lists. Against the old code, ?q=%25 and ?q=_ would return extra items, so they would fail. I did not run them: the cloudflare:workers pool is likely not runnable here, and CI runs them.
The README only says ?q= searches titles, which is still accurate. Nothing stale.
The regex escapes backslash, % and _ before the wrapping %. ESCAPE '\' in the JS string yields ESCAPE '\' in SQL, a single backslash. The query is still parameterised.
The query stays parameterised. The escaping removes user-controlled wildcards. HTML output is still escaped.

No UI files in the diff.
The title is under 72 characters. The claims match the diff: ESCAPE clause, escaping, new test, no tests deleted.
